requirements: R1: Fix HTTP 401 errors on endpoints that must answer 200/201 to resolve the 15 test failures

R3: Investigate and stop the actual mechanism or process that is occupying port 18080 instead of merely parameterizing the docker-compose binding

slices.title: Resolve Self-Falsification Batch Findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fixes for this epic, I want to resolve the HTTP 401 errors, fix the review stub, and stop the process occupying port 18080, so that the CI pipeline passes reliably.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API is accessed with valid credentials, When the request is processed, Then it should answer with 200/201 instead of 401.
Given the automated review pipeline executes, When it processes the review queue, Then it should fail or skip non-existent PRs like #0 instead of claiming approval.
Given the application starts, When it attempts to bind to port 18080, Then it should succeed because the actual mechanism occupying the port has been identified and altered, not just bypassed.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Multiple distinct root causes (auth, review pipeline, port bindings)
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 0 unresolved findings and 100% test pass rate
